# sonrai_control_transaction (Data Source)

Reads a control transaction, optionally waiting for it to reach a terminal status.

To confirm a rollout, deploy the template with `aws_cloudformation_stack`, then set `wait_for = "COMPLETED"` here with `depends_on` referencing the stack.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deploy the template the submission produced.
resource "aws_cloudformation_stack" "firewall_controls" {
  name         = "SonraiCloudPermissionFirewall"
  template_url = sonrai_control_submission.firewall.template_location
  capabilities = ["CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM"]
}

# Wait for the firewall to confirm the rollout landed.
data "sonrai_control_transaction" "firewall" {
  transaction_id = sonrai_control_submission.firewall.transaction_id
  wait_for       = "COMPLETED"

  depends_on = [aws_cloudformation_stack.firewall_controls]
}

output "firewall_rollout" {
  value = {
    transaction = data.sonrai_control_transaction.firewall.transaction_id
    status      = data.sonrai_control_transaction.firewall.status
    detail      = data.sonrai_control_transaction.firewall.status_message
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `transaction_id` (String) Transaction to read, from `sonrai_control_submission.<name>.transaction_id`.

### Optional

- `wait_for` (String) Terminal status to wait for, one of `COMPLETED`, `FAILED` or `CANCELLED`. Omit to read the transaction once without waiting. Reaching a terminal status other than this one is an error.
- `wait_timeout` (String) How long to wait, as a Go duration such as `30m`. Only read when `wait_for` is set. Defaults to `30m`, and cannot exceed `24h`, the point at which a transaction expires. Reaching `COMPLETED` includes the CloudFormation rollout, which can take a couple of hours on a first rollout across a very large organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `transaction_id`.
- `root_scope` (String) Root scope this transaction belongs to.
- `status` (String) Transaction status reported by the platform.
- `status_message` (String) Human-readable detail accompanying the status.
- `template_location` (String) CloudFormation template this transaction produced, empty when none was needed.
